XData.name: DTL
XData.Data: <transform sourceClass='EnsLib.EDI.XML.Document' targetClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' sourceDocType='ALLER:AllergyInfo' targetDocType='2.3:ADT_A01' create='existing' language='objectscript' > <trace value='"In AL1"' /> <foreach property='source.{allergies()}' key='k1' > <trace value='source.{allergies(k1).allergen}' /> <assign value='source.{allergies(k1).allergyType}' property='target.{AL1(k1):AllergyType}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{allergies(k1).allergyType}' property='target.{AL1(k1):AllergyType}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{transactionCode}' property='target.{AL1(k1):AllergyCodeMnemonicDescripti.identifier}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{allergies(k1).allergen}' property='target.{AL1(k1):AllergyCodeMnemonicDescripti.text}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{allergies(k1).severity}' property='target.{AL1(k1):AllergySeverity}' action='set' /> <if condition='source.{allergies(k1).reactions()}' > <true> <assign value='source.{allergies(k1).reactions()}' property='target.{AL1(k1):AllergyReaction}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <if condition='source.{allergies(k1).occurrenceTime.dateTimeOccurred} '= ""' > <true> <assign value='source.{allergies(k1).occurrenceTime.dateTimeOccurred}' property='target.{AL1(k1):IdentificationDate}' action='set' /> </true> <false> <assign value='source.{allergies(k1).occurrenceTime.approximate}' property='target.{AL1(k1):IdentificationDate}' action='set' /> </false> </if> </foreach> <trace value='"AL1 done"' /> </transform>
